results.title: The Beginner’s Guide to Coachella: What to Pack, Where to Stay, How to Set Up Camp, and More
results.content:
Every year, the music festival is held at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. This year, the 2026 festival will take place over two consecutive spring weekends:

   Weekend 1: Friday, April 10–Sunday, April 12, 2026
   Weekend 2: Friday, April 17–Sunday, April 19, 2026

The Coachella gates open at 11 a.m. and the first musical sets usually kick off around noon. The festival usually closes around 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday and 12 a.m. on Sunday night.

results.title: Coachella 2027 Dates Announced | Pitchfork
results.content:
We’re not even a full 24 hours out from when weekend two of the 2026 Coachella Valley Music and Arts Festival wrapped up, so you know what that means: the 2027 dates have been announced. The first weekend of next year’s Coachella is set for Friday, April 9, through Sunday, April 11. The second weekend will take place from Friday, April 16, through, Sunday, April 18. For the honors, the music festival will once again descend on the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. Tickets go on sale on May [...] go on sale on May 1 via Coachella’s website. [...] Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G headlined Coachella 2026, while other acts like David Byrne, the xx, Turnstile, FKA twigs, Addison Rae, Geese, and Oklou rounded out the bill.
